verdict.rationale: CHKit, ObsessionDB's own tool, defines schema and pipelines as code that can be validated, tested, and deployed in CI "with a diff you can review". That covers the versioning and review parts of the story for pipeline-style automations. Rolling back automations is not documented: point-in-time recovery and time travel restore database state, which is an adjacent data-rollback control rather than reverting an automation or deploy. missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of deployed pipelines or automations, explicit version history for automations such as alert rules or refreshable views, depth of CHKit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
